observed_source_findings: Five missing shell activities are explicitly included in the normal shell APK source list of the frozen Chromium reference revision.
Their real layout, view ID and title resources remain in the installed APK; no resource rewrite is needed to express the reference contracts.
The installed manifest has no custom Application, appComponentFactory or classLoader override.
All 19 APK-owned classes contain no static references to the six missing activities and no ClassLoader, DexClassLoader, loadClass or Class.forName calls.
This excludes an APK-owned redirection found in the inspected source; it is not an executed proof about every framework or instrumentation classpath.

five_normal_apk_contracts.contract: Create and attach a WebView, destroy the previous instance on new intent, load the supplied URL or about:blank, and destroy on Activity teardown.
Expose a real WebView with console capture, explicit completion sentinel, bounded wait/result APIs, and caller-controlled permission test hooks.
Create WebViews on the UI thread or a dedicated Looper, send load operations on the correct thread, expose bounded completion APIs, and tear down only the owned view and thread.
five_normal_apk_contracts.resource_requirement: Programmatic UI; no additional APK resource required.
five_normal_apk_contracts.actual_dependency_gap: The reference uses org.chromium.base.Log in two diagnostic paths; that class is absent from all 19 installed classes.
five_normal_apk_contracts.minimal_dependency_option: Use the framework android.util.Log for those two diagnostic calls rather than importing a Chromium base library solely for logging.
five_normal_apk_contracts.lifecycle_review_needed: Review callback/latch races, a teardown before Handler publication, and the reference's unbounded thread join before proposing a production candidate.

five_normal_apk_contracts.contract: Inflate the actual WebView layout and return the live WebView through the instrumentation-facing getWebView API.
Load an intent URL, optionally start WebView tracing, stop it into an output stream, report load/tracing duration and finish only after completion.
five_normal_apk_contracts.resource_requirement: Programmatic UI; no additional APK resource required.
five_normal_apk_contracts.lifecycle_review_needed: The reference has a fixed private trace filename and a newly created executor; ownership of a pre-existing trace file, executor shutdown and destroy/error paths need explicit review.

Use the existing verified signing identity and retain the exact installed base for reversible upgrade and data preservation review.
Treat the pinned upstream revision as a contract source, not as an established complete source baseline for this installed build.
